### Important Info

![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticket Purchase

- **This is a non-reserved bus; it is not possible to purchase or reserve tickets in advance.**
- Please purchase your bus ticket on the day of travel and then join the boarding queue. Boarding is on a first-come, first-served basis, and purchasing a ticket does not guarantee that you will be able to board your preferred service.
- If you board the bus at a stop without a ticket counter, you can buy your ticket from the bus driver when boarding, using cash or Visa contactless card. (IC cards such as SUICA are not accepted.)

![timetable-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/timetable-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=timetable-icon.png)Timetable Updates

- **We typically update this timetable in late March.**
- If the schedule for next year is not yet available, please be patient for its release. **We kindly ask that you refrain from inquiring about the release of the new timetable,** as we cannot provide more details than what is available on the timetable page.
- The timetable is not expected to change significantly from last year, so please refer to the timetable from the previous year until the updated one becomes available.

![concern-bus-full-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/concern-bus-full-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=concern-bus-full-icon.png)Group Reservation

- We do not accept reservation requests, regardless of the number of passengers or requests from travel agencies.

![luggage-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/luggage-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=luggage-icon.png)Luggage Allowance

This bus has a luggage compartment where you can stow your suitcases. There are no restrictions on the number or size of items.


![bus-pass-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-pass-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-pass-icon.png)About Tateyama Route Option Ticket

- You cannot board the bus by just showing the QR code.
- Seat reservations are also not available. If the bus is full, please wait for the next available bus.
- [Please check the instructions on how to receive your ticket and board the bus from this link.](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/info/web_ticket.html?newwindow=true&wid=-3060467767230323003&_gl=1*1svj8dy*_ga*MzA1MjcyNTEyLjE3NDM0NzYwNDI.*_ga_8MQPY5SC52*MTc0MzQ3NjA0Mi4xLjEuMTc0MzQ3NjA2OC4wLjAuMA..) (Click on the " **STEP3: Receive Tickets**" Tab.)

If you have further inquiries, please inquire the [operating company](https://www.alpen-route.com/en/) directly. Thank you.

![bus-pass-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-pass-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-pass-icon.png)About Alpine-Takayama-Matsumoto Area Tourist Pass

You **cannot** use the Alpine-Takayama-Matsumoto Area Tourist Passto board Nagano - Omachi/Ogizawa bus.


![reservation-error-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/reservation-error-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=reservation-error-icon.png)Boarding the bus between Shinano-Omachi Station and Holiday Inn Resore Kuroyon

You cannot board the bus between Shinano-Omachi Station and Holiday Inn Resort Kuroyon. Please use the [Shinano Omachi – Ogisawa Line](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/omachi-ogizawa?hsLang=en) for this section.


### Fare

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Nagano Station ～ Shinano Omachi Station | Adult | 2,900 yen |
| Nagano Station ～ Omachi Onsen-kyo / Holiday Inn Resort Kuroyon | Adult | 3,400 yen |
| Nagano Station ～ Ogizawa | Adult | 4,300 yen |

\*\*Only one-way tickets are available; there is no round-trip fare.

##### About Child Fares

- **Age 0:** Free of charge. However, if a child occupies a seat, a child fare ticket is required. Please note that by law, children are counted as passengers even when they do not occupy a seat (e.g., when sitting on a parent’s lap). If all seats are taken and a child does not have their own seat and ticket, this will be considered over capacity, and boarding may be denied.
- **Age 1-** **12:** Child fare (half of adult price)
- **Age 13+:** Adult Fare

### Important Info (for green season)

[Click here for the timetable and details for winter season >](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/timetable/hakuba-nagano-winter-reserved?hsLang=en)

![ticketing-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/ticketing-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=ticketing-icon.png)Ticketing

- You cannot reserve a seat or buy a ticket in advance, even one day prior. Boarding is on a first-come, first-served basis, and purchasing a ticket does not guarantee that you will be able to board your preferred service.
- Please purchase your ticket on the day of boarding, and then join the boarding queue.

- The bus ticket for the Nagano to Hakuba line that you purchased allows you to board any bus on the same day.

- If you are concerned that the bus might be full, please line up early.
- We add more buses during busy times. But if the bus becomes full, please board the next available bus.

![luggage-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/luggage-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=luggage-icon.png)Luggage

- This bus has a luggage compartment where you can stow your suitcases. There are no restrictions on the number or size of items.

![timetable-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/timetable-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=timetable-icon.png)Timetable Updates

- The timetable for the green season will be updated around mid-March.
- We apologize for any inconvenience. We cannot provide the exact release date for the timetable. The schedule will be posted on the timetable page once it has been confirmed.
- If the schedule for next year is not yet available, we kindly ask for your patience. Please refrain from inquiring about the release date, as we cannot offer additional details beyond what is provided on the timetable page.
- This bus service operates year-round, with only minor changes to the schedule compared to last year. Until the updated timetable is released, you may refer to last year's schedule as a guide.

![toilet-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/toilet-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=toilet-icon.png)Onboard Facilities

- This bus does not have a restroom onboard, and there are no restroom breaks during the journey.
- This bus is not equipped with a wheelchair lift or designated wheelchair space, so it cannot accommodate passengers who wish to remain in their wheelchair during the journey. Please fold your wheelchair and store it in the bus's luggage compartment. Kindly note that unfolded wheelchairs cannot be accepted.

# Traveling by Bus

![](https://go-nagano.a.kuroco-img.app/v=1678930124/files/user/50995872627_bfc0bb3eab_c.jpg)An Alpico bus driving along the highlands of Norikura

Japan’s buses tend to be cheaper than taking the train, and visitors can easily access hotspots in Nagano Prefecture by bus. Expressway buses run to and from Japan’s major cities, while local loop buses run within Nagano City and Matsumoto City. Nagano is also home to Japan’s highest bus stop near Mt. Norikura’s summit sitting at an altitude of 2,700 meters! Other local buses allow for easy access to popular locations such as Kamikochi, Togakushi, Tsumago, and Jigokudani Wild Snow Monkey Park.

## Expressway Buses and Express Buses

- Depending on the route, rides may take between 3.5 and 9 hours, usually including a rest stop every 2 to 3 hours. Overnight buses also are available.

- Most expressway buses are equipped with bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and power outlets.

- Buses also have space for large luggage and suitcases. Staff will help load luggage outside before boarding.


### Boarding Buses

- Bus information and online reservations are available in a variety of languages at [Japan Bus Online](https://japanbusonline.com/en).

- Show the driver your ticket or confirmation email when boarding and disembarking.

- Seat reservations can be made for most buses.


### Main Routes

- Osaka/Kyoto/Nagoya/Shinjuku – Nagano City

- Osaka/Kyoto/Shinjuku – Hakuba

- Osaka/Kyoto/Shinjuku/Nagoya – Matsumoto

- Osaka/Kyoto/Nagoya – Iida/Komagane/Ina

- Takayama – Matsumoto

- Nagano – Matsumoto (weekdays only)


## Sightseeing Buses

- Rides may take between 45 and 90 minutes. These are the same buses as those used on express routes, so luggage space is available.


### Boarding Buses

- Please reserve online or purchase a ticket at the ticket counter.

- Show the driver your ticket or confirmation email when boarding and disembarking.

- Most seats are unreserved seats.

- Press the stop button when nearing your bus stop to alert the driver.


### Main Routes

- Nagano – Jigokudani Wild Snow Monkey Park – Shiga Kogen

- Nagano – Togakushi

- Nagano – Hakuba

- Shin-Shimashima – Kamikochi/Norikura/Shirahone


## Local Buses

Use these buses to get around within a given city or escape to a countryside spot. You may even get a chance to interact with locals!

### Boarding Buses

- Most buses are boarded from a door located at the center of the bus. Use the door at the front when disembarking.

- Take a ticket when boarding, and then insert both the ticket and the fare in the device at the front when disembarking. The fare is displayed on a monitor at the front of the bus.

- Fare should be paid in cash or in a charged card for buses. Most local buses do not take electronic payments. You cannot receive change, so please pay with the exact amount. You may need to convert bills if you lack small change.

- Press the stop button when nearing your bus stop to alert the driver.


### Main Routes

- Gururin Route (Nagano City loop bus)

- Binzuru Route (Nagano Station - Zenkoji Temple)

- Town Sneaker (Matsumoto City excursion bus)

- Yudanaka Station - Jigokudani Wild Snow Monkey Park - Shiga Kogen

- Nagiso Station – Tsumago/Magome

- Karuizawa Town loop bus

- Komagane Station - Shirabidaira (Mt. Komagatake ropeway boarding spot)

Togakushi – Nagano Sightseeing Bus (Starts from April 1, 2025)


- Starting from December 6, 2025, this winter bus will make a stop at the Okusha Tokusha Bus Stop, the entrance to the ancient cedar tree path. From the bus stop, it takes about a 20-minute walk to the red Zuishinmon Gate.
- To ensure passenger safety and comfort, **all seats require a reservation**. You don’t have to worry about not getting a seat due to full capacity.
- You can store your suitcases and large luggage in the trunk room.

![reservation-error-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/reservation-error-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=reservation-error-icon.png)Troubles while making a reservation online

- Alpico does not handle the operation of the reservation website. If you encounter issues like your card being denied, the reservation page loading slowly, not sure what to fill in the form, error occuring while proceeding, or being unable to proceed despite availability, etc., please reach out to Keio Dentetsu, which is the company that manages the reservation website, directly at [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) for help.
- We often receive inquiries about card denials, but when we test it, it usually works fine. So, please try using other cards or attempt booking later the next day or contact your card issuer.
- When making a reservation online, if your country phone number has less than 9 digits, add a 0 at the beginning to meet the requirement (9-11 digits).
- If you don’t see the bus you want to book on the booking website,it means that bus is full. Please choose another available bus.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- To check seat availability for the reserved bus, please visit the reservation page. If the bus is fully booked, you will see indicators such as “×”, “No Seat Available”, or “Not Available”. We will not answer to the inquiries about the seat availability.
- When making a reservation, please check this box (reCAPTCHA) to proceed with your booking.

![i-am-not-robot](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/i-am-not-robot.png?width=439&height=184&name=i-am-not-robot.png)

##### **Ticket Reservation**

- Please make a reservation by yourself. We do not accept reservation requests, regardless of the number of passengers or requests from travel agencies.
- The online reservation system and the ticket counter share the same seat availability.If online bookings show no available seats, the ticket counter will have the same status.
- If you encounter any issues while making a reservation, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.

##### **Ticket Cancellation**

- Please access " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page and proceed with the reservation cancellation.
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

##### **Ticket Change**

- You cannot change your reservation information (time/date/name etc.). Please cancel and make a new reservation by yourself online from [this page](https://japanbusonline.com/en/BookInquiry).
- If you cannot log into "My Reservation" page, please contact [info@highwaybus.com](mailto:info@highwaybus.com) or use the [Contact Form](https://japantripsearch.com/). Alpico does not manage the reservation system.
- Cancellation fee applies 100 yen per person.

![bus-location-icon](https://visit-nagano.alpico.co.jp/hs-fs/hubfs/images/icon/bus-location-icon.png?width=500&height=500&name=bus-location-icon.png)How to Board the Bus

- **Boarding Location**

Please board the bus from bus stop no. 7 near Nagano station Zenkoji exit.  The bus stop is in front of the Alpico Bus Ticket Office. ( [Google Map](https://www.google.com/maps/place/%E3%82%A2%E3%83%AB%E3%83%94%E3%82%B3%E4%BA%A4%E9%80%9A+%E9%95%B7%E9%87%8E%E9%A7%85%E5%89%8D%E6%A1%88%E5%86%85%E6%89%80/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x0:0x299d8f3be9e631ca?sa=X&ved=1t:2428&ictx=111))

- **How to Board the Bus**

After purchasing tickets online, you can confirm and make changes to the ticket type from the " [My Reservation](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbRsvSearch)" page. There are two types of online tickets.

**1\. Mobile Ticket (Recommended):**

Show the ticket on your smartphone screen when boarding.

- After completing your reservation and payment, click the **"Send Mobile Ticket"** button.
- A link to your mobile ticket will be sent to your registered email.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click **"Send Mobile Ticket"** again to resend the ticket.

**2\. Web Ticket:**

Print out the ticket and show it to the bus staff or driver when boarding.

- After purchasing a ticket online, click the **"Display/Print Web Ticket"** button.
- This will open the ticket for you to print.
- If needed, you can log into the **"My Reservation"** page and click " **Display/Print Web Ticket"** button again to resend the ticket.

[See how to board the bus (video) >](https://highway-buses.jp/movie/boarding/en.mp4)

Nagaden operates a variety of express bus services to some of Nagano’s most popular destinations including [Shiga Kogen Ski Resort](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/?p=41129) and surrounding [Joshinetsu Kogen National Park](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/?p=53922). On this page you will find the following information:

### Contents:

- [Shiga Kogen Express Bus Timetable](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/access/nagaden-shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable/#shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable)
- [Ticketing & Travel Passes](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/access/nagaden-shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable/#Ticketing-&-Travel-Passes)
- [Shiga Kogen Ski Resort: Everything You Need to Know](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/access/nagaden-shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable/#Shiga-Kogen-Ski-Resort:-Everything-You-Need-to-Know)
- [Tours and Charters to/from Shiga Kogen](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/access/nagaden-shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable/#Tours-and-Charters-from-Shiga-Kogen)

Express bus services operate all year round with an increase in services during winter, to cover peak season. The express bus operates to and from **Bus Stop No.23** outside the **East Exit** of [Nagano Station](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/?p=13523). Tickets are bought directly from the driver once on the bus. For full details regarding how to use Nagaden's express bus services, please refer to [our 'Nagaden Express Snow Monkey / Shiga Kogen Express Bus' page](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/?p=13473).

During the green season, a one-way journey from Nagano Station to Shiga Kogen (or the reverse journey) costs: **JPY2,200 to JPY2,500 per adult** depending on which part of the resort you are heading to/from, and going all the way to Kusatsu Onsen would cost around **JPY 4,200**.

During the winter season, all buses from Nagano Station to Shiga Kogen are **JPY3,000 per adult** one-way.

### **Shiga Kogen Express Bus Timetable**

- [Shiga Kogen Express Bus Timetable for Spring, Summer, and Fall 2026 UPDATED (April 7th 2026 to December 4th 2026)](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/access/nagaden-shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable/#summer-april-to-december-timetable)
- [Shiga Kogen Express Bus Timetable for Winter 2026-27 UPDATED (December 5th 2026 to April 5th 2027)](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/access/nagaden-shiga-kogen-express-bus-timetable/#shiga-kogen-winter-timetable)

[![shiga-kogen-large-map](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/messageImage_1602644085984-1.jpg)](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/shiga-kogen-lift-map.webp)

From Nagano Station, the bus just over an hour to reach the first stop in Shiga Kogen - Sun Valley - or for services that continue that far, almost two hours to reach Kusatsu Onsen. [Shiga Kogen Yamanoeki (Mountain Station)](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/?p=29045) is a stop on all services, making it a convenient point to disembark and board the bus while in Shiga.

![shiga-yamanoeki-banner-edit](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/shiga-yamanoeki-banner-edit-2.png)

The 'Pulse Gondola' will operates from Shiga Kogen Yamanoeki making it the easiest and quickest point to access the resort. The schedules below operate outside of winter with all stated prices the cost of a single adult ticket:

Please feel free to click on the images below to increase their display size.

### **Ticketing & Travel Passes**

![](https://www.snowmonkeyresorts.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/nagaden-bus-exterior.webp)

The Nagaden Shiga Kogen Express Bus is a **non-reserved service**. You do not need to book in advance; simply line up at the bus stop and board on a first-come, first-served basis. Although there are some ways to purchase a ticket in advance, it does not guarantee a spot on the bus.

#### **Boarding & Fare Payment (Cash, Card, and IC)**

For passengers not using a travel pass, the process is simple:

- **How to Pay:** Payment is made **when exiting the bus** at your destination.
- **Accepted Payment Methods:** **Cash** ( **outside of weekends and holidays**) **PayPay, AliPay, Credit Cards** (Visa, JCB, Amex, Mastercard), and **IC Cards** (Suica, PASMO).
- **One-Way Fare:** During the winter season, all buses from Nagano Station to Shiga Kogen cost **JPY 3,000** per adult one-way. During the green season, fares depend on drop-off location, between **JPY 2,200** to **JPY 4,200** per adult.
- **Note:** During peak winter periods, we recommend arriving at Bus Stop No. 23 at least 15–20 minutes before departure to help ensure a seat.
- **Where to Board:** Bus Stop 23 outside the Eastern Exit of Nagano Station.
- **Additional Note for Weekends/Holidays**:
- **Cash Tip:** This bus runs as a **cashless** bus on weekends and holidays. If you intend to pay with cash, you **cannot** pay on the bus on weekends/holidays. You must buy a paper ticket at the "Aruyo" ticket office at Nagano Station East Exit beforehand.

**Do I need to book my bus seat to Shiga Kogen in advance?**

No. The Nagaden Shiga Kogen Express Bus is a **non-reserved service**. Seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis. During the peak winter ski season (December–March), we recommend arriving at **Nagano Station East Exit Bus Stop No. 23** at least 15–20 minutes before your scheduled departure to ensure a seat.

**How much does the bus to Shiga Kogen cost?**

During the winter season, all buses from Nagano Station to Shiga Kogen cost **JPY 3,000** per adult one-way.

During the summer season, the fare depends on your final destination within the resort. A one-way journey from Nagano Station to **Sun Valley or Yamanoeki** costs approximately **JPY 2,200 to JPY 2,500**. If you are traveling all the way to **Kusatsu Onsen**, the fare is approximately **JPY 4,200**. Payment is made to the driver when you exit the bus.

**Can I pay with cash on the bus?**

**Yes and No.** On weekdays, cash is accepted directly on the bus. However, on **weekends and public holidays**, this service operates as a **cashless bus**. If you wish to pay with cash on a weekend, you must purchase a paper ticket in advance at the "Aruyo" ticket machine located at the Nagaden Bus Ticket Center (Nagano Station East Exit, 1st Floor) before boarding.

**Which credit cards and IC cards are accepted?**

The bus accepts touch-payment **Credit Cards** (Visa, JCB, Amex, Mastercard), **QR payments** (PayPay, AliPay), and **IC Cards** (Suica, PASMO). Simply tap your card or scan the code when exiting the bus.

**Does the Snow Monkey Pass cover the bus to Shiga Kogen?**

**No.** The Snow Monkey Pass is only valid for travel between Nagano Station and the Snow Monkey Park, and cannot be used on the Shiga Kogen Express Bus.

**Where is the best place to get off the bus in Shiga Kogen?**

For most visitors, **Shiga Kogen Yamanoeki (Mountain Station)** is the best stop. It serves as the central hub of the resort, offers coin lockers and a rest area, and provides immediate access to the **Pulse Gondola**, which connects you to the central giant ski fields.

**Can I bring my ski gear and luggage on the bus?**

Yes. Nagaden Express buses are equipped with **under-floor luggage compartments** specifically designed to hold large suitcases, skis, and snowboards. There is no extra charge for stowing your gear in these compartments.

**Is the bus schedule the same for Summer and Winter?**

No. Nagaden operates two distinct schedules. The **Winter Schedule** (Dec–Apr) features high-frequency service for skiers, while the **Spring/Summer/Fall Schedule** (Apr–Dec) has fewer departures but includes the scenic route all the way to **Kusatsu Onsen**. Always check the specific dates on this page before traveling.

# Nagano to Hakuba

Nagano to Hakuba in about an hour by Alpico bus or Nagano Snow Shuttle. Full timetables in both directions, jumbo taxi fares and car hire options.

![Nagano station](https://hakubacollection.imgix.net/hakuba/nagano-station.jpg?auto=compress&crop=focalpoint&domain=hakubacollection.imgix.net&fit=crop&fm=pjpg&fp-x=0.5&fp-y=0.5&h=270&ixlib=php-3.3.1&w=480)

## Nagano to Hakuba Bus

The most common way for travellers to get to Hakuba from Nagano Station is by bus, which takes about an hour. **The Alpico bus ride costs ¥2900 for adults and ¥1450 for children ages 1-12 during the summer. Children under one can ride for free if they don't need a seat. The Nagano Snow Shuttle fare is a flat ¥3,750 for both adults and children (winter season). Please see below for a combined bus schedule for both the Nagano Snow Shuttle and Alpico Bus.**

- To purchase non-reserved Alpico bus tickets to Hakuba, go to the JR Green Ticket Office, located to your right as you exit the bullet train gates. To purchase [Alpico Bus](https://www.highwaybus.com/gp/inbound/inbPlanList?lineId=248) or [Nagano Snow Shuttle](https://naganosnowshuttle.com/make-a-reservation/?NSSRef=THC) tickets, you need to book online.
- To get to the bus stop, take the elevator on the left side of the east exit of Nagano Station down to the ground floor. From there, walk to the bus stop (1 min walk) to catch the Alpico bus (#26) or Nagano Snow Shuttle (#25 and #26) bound for Hakuba. For the reserved buses, you need to check in at least 5 minutes before departure.
- During the winter season, the last bus to Hakuba departs from Nagano Station at 20:30. **If you miss it, Uber is still available, but chartered jumbo taxis may not be available on short notice.**
- If the Alpico non-reserved bus is full, they usually put another bus into service on short notice if available.
- When you arrive in Hakuba, it is best to get off at the Happo Bus Terminal (also called the Happo Information Centre). This bus stop is centrally located and has an English-speaking help desk, free Wi-Fi, a coffee shop, bathrooms, and an indoor waiting area. There are a couple of coffee shops to wait in at Hakuba Station.

## Nagano to Hakuba Taxi

Five different companies offer a chartered jumbo taxi service from Nagano Station. However, please remember that you need to know the exact arrival time of your bullet train to book this service. Without this information, the taxi companies will not accept your booking. The estimated time for the ride is one hour.

- **Due to the potential lack of availability and slow response times from the taxi companies, we highly recommend reserving this service weeks in advance, especially during peak times like holidays and weekends. You can use the booking buttons below to make a reservation.**
- You must know your bullet train number or arrival time at Nagano Station to book a jumbo taxi.
- If you need a regular taxi, download the Uber app to book a taxi from Nagano to Hakuba.

## Rent a Car in Nagano

Renting a car at Nagano Station and driving to Hakuba is a great way to avoid the wait and cost for the bus to Hakuba and have the convenience of a vehicle to get around the Hakuba Valley during your stay. The estimated time and cost is about 1 hour, and the cost depends on the size of the car. For instance, a Toyota Noah will cost around ¥18,000 per day from [Toyota Rent a Car](https://thehakubacollection.com/guest-services/car-rental).

- It's important to note that if you are traveling to Hakuba during the winter months, you will need to reserve a 4WD with winter tires as an additional option with availability, depending on the pick-up location.
